description: The form's fields with names and types. ALWAYS call it before create_record and before building a newsletter, to know the exact names and html_name of the fields. A link field (rel) also says how many rows of this form hold a link (rows_linked), how many rows the linked table has (linked_table_rows), and any links to no row or to another table; a linked_column says what it shows. When someone asks why a lookup or a linked column is empty, answer from these facts, in the person's words (never these key names): rows_linked 0 with linked_table_rows > 0 means the rows exist but none picks one yet — say so and offer to pick them; do not add a new link field.
name: get_form_fields
